findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_postal_code · Private data: lookup_corporate_number, search_corporation_by_name · Public sink: lookup_postal_code, search_postal_code, normalize_address.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_postal_code · Private data: lookup_corporate_number, search_corporation_by_name · Public sink: lookup_postal_code, search_postal_code, normalize_address

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
